name: @feimacode/open-design-gateway
description: The hosted Open Design MCP gateway (openspec add-mcp-gateway): the kit's tools over HTTPS for the Claude connector and ChatGPT plugin directory listings, with project handles, optional sign-in through feima-idp, export links and read-only viewer links. Never published to npm; it ships as the open-design-gateway container image and takes packages/mcp-server's version.
